The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1933–1934''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[AFC Ajax]] won this year's championship by beating [[KFC (football club)|KFC]], [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]], [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]] and [[Velocitas 1897]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HVV Hengelo]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[AFC Ajax]], [[HFC Haarlem]] and [[Sparta Rotterdam]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Koninklijke HFC]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[DHC Delft]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]] and [[RCH (football club)|RCH]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[SBV Excelsior]]
